answer: Require each agent to earn a nontransferable stake before it can influence a shared reputation graph: each new identity must lock scarce tokens, and its rewards vest only after completing independently checked tasks. A cluster of fake accounts then cannot multiply voting power for free; the attacker must fund every vertex and keep capital tied up while risking slashing for collusion. Even a quiet knoll or narrow inlet in the network offers no cheap route around the stake requirement.
